mapper.select: SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) skuId,p.name productName,s.specs_json specsJson,CAST(s.price_minor AS CHAR) priceMinor, s.enabled skuEnabled,p.state productState,c.enabled categoryEnabled,b.enabled brandEnabled, (SELECT a.storage_key FROM product_asset pa JOIN asset a ON a.id=pa.asset_id AND a.visibility='PUBLIC' WHERE pa.product_id=p.id ORDER BY pa.sort_order,a.id LIMIT 1) imageKey FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id WHERE s.id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY s.id
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id, name, CAST(parent_id AS CHAR) parentId, sort_order sort, enabled, version FROM category ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id, name, enabled, version FROM brand ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
FROM product p WHERE p.id = CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id, CAST(product_id AS CHAR) productId, code, specs_json specsJson, CAST(price_minor AS CHAR) priceMinor, enabled, version FROM sku WHERE product_id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY product_id, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE enabled = TRUE
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id, name, CAST(parent_id AS CHAR) parentId, sort_order sort, enabled, version FROM category WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brand WHERE enabled = TRUE
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id, name, enabled, version FROM brand WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.enabled = TRUE JOIN brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id AND b.enabled = TRUE JOIN (SELECT product_id, MIN(price_minor) min_price FROM sku WHERE enabled = TRUE GROUP BY product_id) sp ON sp.product_id = p.id WHERE p.state = 'ON_SALE' AND p.name LIKE #{filter.keyword} ESCAPE '!' AND p.category_id = CAST(#{filter.categoryId} AS UNSIGNED) AND p.brand_id = CAST(#{filter.brandId} AS UNSIGNED) AND sp.min_price >= CAST(#{filter.minPriceMinor} AS UNSIGNED) AND sp.min_price <= CAST(#{filter.maxPriceMinor} AS UNSIGNED) AND p.featured = #{filter.featured}

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) id, p.name, CAST(p.category_id AS CHAR) categoryId, CAST(p.brand_id AS CHAR) brandId, p.description, p.featured, p.state, p.rating_sum ratingSum, p.rating_count ratingCount, p.version, p.created_at createdAt
mapper.select:
ORDER BY sp.min_price ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY sp.min_price DESC, p.id ASC ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{filter.size} OFFSET #{filter.offset}

FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.enabled = TRUE JOIN brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id AND b.enabled = TRUE WHERE p.id = CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND p.state = 'ON_SALE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.enabled = TRUE)

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id, CAST(product_id AS CHAR) productId, code, specs_json specsJson, CAST(price_minor AS CHAR) priceMinor, enabled, version FROM sku WHERE enabled = TRUE AND product_id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY product_id, id

SELECT CAST(a.id AS CHAR) id, CAST(pa.product_id AS CHAR) productId, a.storage_key storageKey, a.content_type contentType, a.size_bytes sizeBytes FROM product_asset pa JOIN asset a ON a.id = pa.asset_id AND a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' WHERE pa.product_id IN CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY pa.product_id, pa.sort_order, a.id
